title.en: A counter that remembers its state

explanation.zh-CN: remember + mutableStateOf 保存计数，点击按钮修改状态后 Text 自动重组。本例为只读示例：App 内不运行 Android 代码。
explanation.en: remember with mutableStateOf stores the count; clicking the button changes state and Text recomposes automatically. Read-only sample: Android code does not run inside the app.

note.zh-CN: remember 让状态跨重组保留
note.en: remember keeps the state across recompositions

title.zh-CN: 状态提升后的无状态组件
title.en: A stateless component after state hoisting

explanation.zh-CN: Counter 只接收 value 与 onIncrement，自身不持有状态，调用方决定状态放在哪里。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: Counter receives only value and onIncrement and holds no state itself; the caller decides where state lives. Read-only sample.

note.en: The event callback is passed up
The button only forwards the click event

title.zh-CN: 用 rememberSaveable 跨配置变更保存输入
title.en: rememberSaveable keeps input across configuration changes

explanation.zh-CN: rememberSaveable 把临时界面状态写入保存状态，旋转屏幕重建界面后输入内容仍在。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: rememberSaveable saves transient UI state so text survives the UI recreation caused by rotation. Read-only sample.

note.en: Restored automatically after a configuration change

note.zh-CN: 受控输入框：值来自状态
note.en: Controlled text field whose value comes from state

title.zh-CN: 带稳定 key 的列表

explanation.zh-CN: LazyColumn 只组合可见项，items 提供 key 让列表在重排时保留条目状态。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: LazyColumn composes only visible items; items provides keys so row state survives reordering. Read-only sample.

note.en: items declares the rows and their keys

title.en: Loading data when the screen opens

explanation.zh-CN: LaunchedEffect(userId) 在首次组合和 userId 变化时启动协程加载数据，避免在组合函数体内直接做 IO。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: LaunchedEffect(userId) launches a coroutine on first composition and whenever userId changes, avoiding IO directly in the composable body. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: key 变化会取消并重启
note.en: Changing the key cancels and restarts the effect

title.zh-CN: 成对注册与注销监听器

explanation.zh-CN: onStart 注册、onStop 注销，保证界面不可见时不再收到回调，避免泄漏与重复回调。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: Register in onStart and unregister in onStop so callbacks stop while the screen is not visible, avoiding leaks and duplicate callbacks. Read-only sample.

note.en: Register when the screen becomes visible
Unregister when the screen is no longer visible

title.zh-CN: 用 ViewModel 跨配置变更保存业务状态
title.en: Persisting business state across configuration changes with a ViewModel

explanation.zh-CN: ViewModel 在配置变更时保留，count 用 mutableStateOf 暴露给 Compose；private set 保证外部只能通过方法修改。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: A ViewModel survives configuration changes and exposes count as mutableStateOf; private set keeps mutation behind methods. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 唯一允许修改状态的入口
note.en: The only allowed mutation entry point

title.zh-CN: 显式 Intent 打开详情页
title.en: Opening a detail screen with an explicit intent

explanation.zh-CN: Intent 明确指定 DetailActivity，extras 携带参数；目标页面从 Intent 中读取并校验参数。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: The intent names DetailActivity explicitly and extras carry the argument; the target reads and validates it. Read-only sample.

title.zh-CN: 隐式 Intent 打开网页并检查可处理应用
title.en: Opening a web page with an implicit intent and a handler check

explanation.zh-CN: ACTION_VIEW 交给系统匹配浏览器；resolveActivity 为 null 时说明没有可处理应用，应给出提示而不是崩溃。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: ACTION_VIEW lets the system match a browser; when resolveActivity is null no app can handle it, so show a message instead of crashing. Read-only sample.

explanation.zh-CN: launcher 在进入组合时注册，点击按钮才启动；uri 为 null 表示用户取消，不应视为错误。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: The launcher is registered during composition and started on click; a null uri means the user cancelled and is not an error. Read-only sample.

note.en: Launch only after the user acts

title.zh-CN: 读取带参数的字符串资源
title.en: Reading a string resource with arguments

explanation.zh-CN: 文案放在 strings.xml 的不同语言目录，代码只引用 R.string 的 key，切换语言时系统自动选择对应文案。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: Copy lives in per-language strings.xml files and code references only the R.string key; the system picks the matching text on language switch. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 在 Compose 中读取资源

title.zh-CN: 从主题读取颜色而不是写死
title.en: Reading colors from the theme instead of hardcoding

explanation.zh-CN: MaterialTheme 提供 colorScheme，组件读取 onSurface 等角色色，深浅色模式切换时自动变化。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: MaterialTheme exposes colorScheme; components read role colors such as onSurface and adapt automatically between light and dark. Read-only sample.

note.en: Entry point for shared design tokens

note.zh-CN: 主题角色色，随模式变化
note.en: Theme role color that follows the mode

title.en: Following the system light and dark mode

explanation.zh-CN: isSystemInDarkTheme 提供系统当前模式，按模式选择 darkColorScheme 或 lightColorScheme。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: isSystemInDarkTheme reports the current system mode and selects darkColorScheme or lightColorScheme accordingly. Read-only sample.

title.zh-CN: 运行时申请相机权限并在拒绝后降级
title.en: Requesting the camera permission and degrading after denial

explanation.zh-CN: RequestPermission 合约返回布尔值；拒绝时调用降级路径，让功能仍然可用而不是崩溃。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: The RequestPermission contract returns a boolean; on denial call a fallback so the feature stays usable instead of crashing. Read-only sample.

note.en: Denial and grant have separate callbacks

title.zh-CN: 在清单中声明权限与 Activity
title.en: Declaring a permission and an Activity in the manifest

explanation.zh-CN: 危险权限与组件都必须先在 AndroidManifest.xml 声明；exported 等属性不能省略，否则安装或运行会被拒绝。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: Dangerous permissions and components must be declared in AndroidManifest.xml; attributes such as exported cannot be omitted or install or runtime will be rejected. Read-only sample.
